statements.note: About relieving student loan debt.

statements.text: A wealthy central region of a state can exploit its poorer regions much as a colonial power exploits colonies.
statements.agree: Rich core regions can subordinate and drain poorer ones inside the same country.
statements.disagree: A wealthy central region of a state cannot exploit its poorer regions much as a colonial power exploits colonies.
statements.note: About whether regional inequality is a form of colonial exploitation.

statements.text: There is a shared human nature that grounds human dignity and rights and should not be redesigned.
statements.agree: A common human nature underlies dignity and rights, and tampering with it is wrong.
statements.disagree: There is not a shared human nature that grounds human dignity and rights and should not be redesigned.
statements.note: About whether human nature is a fixed basis for dignity.

statements.text: Governments should fund independent public service media that are free of government and commercial control.
statements.agree: Publicly funded broadcasters, kept independent, should be part of the news system.
statements.disagree: Governments should not fund independent public service media that are free of government and commercial control.
statements.note: About publicly funded independent media.

statements.text: All authentic religions express one underlying spiritual truth.
statements.agree: Behind their different forms, the great religions point to one shared truth.
statements.disagree: Not all authentic religions express one underlying spiritual truth.
statements.note: About whether the world's religions share one truth.

statements.text: The state should protect farmers from market swings and moneylenders through guaranteed crop prices, public purchase or cooperative credit.
statements.agree: Farmers get price floors, state buying or cheap cooperative credit to keep them secure.
statements.disagree: The state should not protect farmers from market swings and moneylenders through guaranteed crop prices, public purchase or cooperative credit.
statements.note: About state support for farmers.

statements.text: A country should keep its nuclear weapons rather than disarm unilaterally while rival powers hold theirs.
statements.agree: Giving up nuclear arms alone would be unsafe, so a country keeps them until others disarm too.
statements.disagree: Keeping nuclear weapons should not take priority over unilateral disarmament while rival powers hold theirs.
statements.note: About unilateral nuclear disarmament.

statements.text: Working people should have their own political party, independent of the established parties.
statements.agree: Workers need a party of their own to represent their interests in government.
statements.disagree: Working people should not have their own political party, independent of the established parties.
statements.note: About independent parties for working people.

statements.text: Women should have the same legal right as men to inherit and own land.
statements.agree: Daughters and widows inherit and own land on the same terms as sons and husbands.
statements.disagree: Women should not have the same legal right as men to inherit and own land.
statements.note: About equal inheritance and land rights for women.

statements.text: A language spoken in several regions is one language, whatever name each region gives it.
statements.agree: Varieties spoken across regions are one language, even if each region names it differently.
statements.disagree: A language spoken in several regions is not one language, whatever name each region gives it.
statements.note: About whether regional names make separate languages.

statements.text: Polluters should be legally liable to compensate or stop for any proven physical harm to other people's property, rather than being regulated by agencies.
statements.agree: Pollution is settled through lawsuits and injunctions by those harmed, not by agency rules.
statements.disagree: Legal liability for proven physical harm to other people's property should not replace regulation by agencies as the way to deal with polluters.
statements.note: About courts versus regulators for pollution.

statements.text: Customary chiefs should have an official advisory role in making national law.
statements.agree: Customary chiefs should have an official advisory role in making national law.
statements.disagree: Customary chiefs should not have an official advisory role in making national law.
statements.note: About a formal role for traditional chiefs in lawmaking.

statements.text: Protecting the environment should take priority over individual liberty when the two conflict.
statements.agree: Where freedoms damage the environment, they should give way.
statements.disagree: Protecting the environment should not take priority over individual liberty when the two conflict.
statements.note: About trading freedom against environmental protection.

statements.text: Sentences for serious repeat offenders should be fixed by law rather than left to judges' discretion.
statements.agree: Mandatory sentences, such as three strikes, apply whatever a judge might prefer.
statements.disagree: Sentences fixed by law for serious repeat offenders should not replace judges' discretion.
statements.note: About fixed sentences versus judicial discretion.

statements.text: Immigrants should be required to learn the national language.
statements.agree: Learning the language is a duty of settling, and the state may require it.
statements.disagree: Immigrants should not be required to learn the national language.
statements.note: About language requirements for immigrants.

statements.text: Workers should not be required to join or pay a union as a condition of employment.
statements.agree: Union membership and dues are voluntary, and no one can be required to pay them to hold a job.
statements.disagree: Workers may be required to join or pay a union as a condition of employment.
statements.note: About compulsory versus voluntary union membership.

statements.text: Voters should have to show proof of citizenship and identification to vote.
statements.agree: Showing ID and proof of citizenship is a reasonable condition of voting, to protect the integrity of elections.
statements.disagree: Voters should be able to vote without showing proof of citizenship and identification.
statements.note: About identification requirements at the ballot box.

statements.text: No single interpretation of a religion should have legal precedence over others in the state.
statements.agree: The state should treat all streams and interpretations of a religion equally under the law.
statements.disagree: A single interpretation of a religion may have legal precedence over others in the state.
statements.note: About legal standing for different interpretations of a religion.

statements.text: A government is democratic if its rulers are chosen and removed in free and fair competitive elections, whatever policies it pursues.
statements.agree: Democracy is a method for choosing and removing rulers, and fair elections are enough to make a government democratic.
statements.disagree: A government is not democratic merely because its rulers are chosen and removed in free and fair competitive elections, whatever policies it pursues.
statements.note: About what makes a government democratic.

statements.text: Sex before or outside marriage is acceptable for women.
statements.agree: Women may have sexual relationships outside marriage without moral or social censure.
statements.disagree: Sex before or outside marriage is not acceptable for women.
statements.note: About sexual morality and marriage.

statements.text: Governments may cut internet access in a region or the whole country to maintain order.
statements.agree: Shutting down the internet is a legitimate tool in a crisis or unrest.
statements.disagree: Governments may not cut internet access in a region or the whole country to maintain order.
statements.note: About internet shutdowns.

statements.text: Welfare programs should be replaced by a cash payment that shrinks as a person's earnings rise.
statements.agree: One cash payment, withdrawn gradually as income grows, should replace separate welfare programs.
statements.disagree: Welfare programs should not be replaced by a cash payment that shrinks as earnings rise.
statements.note: About a negative income tax versus existing welfare programs.

statements.text: Women should have the same right as men to vote and hold public office.
statements.agree: Women vote and stand for office on the same terms as men.
statements.disagree: Women should not have the same right as men to vote and hold public office.
statements.note: About women's political rights.

statements.text: Religion is a major cause of women's oppression.
statements.agree: Religious teaching and institutions are a main reason women have been held down.
statements.disagree: Religion is not a major cause of women's oppression.
statements.note: About religion's role in women's status.

statements.text: Racial categories are social constructs without a scientific basis.
statements.agree: Races are categories people invented and enforced, not natural divisions.
statements.disagree: Racial categories are not merely social constructs without a scientific basis.
statements.note: About whether race is a social or biological category.

statements.text: Governments should set up dedicated agencies, such as ministries or ombuds, to promote gender equality.
statements.agree: The state should have its own bodies charged with advancing gender equality.
statements.disagree: Governments should not set up dedicated agencies, such as ministries or ombuds, to promote gender equality.
statements.note: About state machinery for gender equality.

statements.text: The first person to claim and work unowned land or resources thereby becomes their rightful owner.
statements.agree: Whoever first claims and works unowned resources owns them.
statements.disagree: Claiming and working unowned land or resources does not by itself make someone their rightful owner.
statements.note: About how property first comes to be owned.

statements.text: Political leaders who commit aggression or atrocities should be tried before international criminal courts.
statements.agree: Leaders answer for aggression and atrocities before courts above the nation.
statements.disagree: Political leaders who commit aggression or atrocities should not be tried before international criminal courts.
statements.note: About international criminal justice for leaders.

statements.text: Scripture is the inerrant word of God and is to be read literally.
statements.agree: Scripture is without error and means what it plainly says.
statements.disagree: Scripture is not the inerrant word of God to be read literally.
statements.note: About how to read religious scripture.

statements.text: Self-government arrangements for Indigenous or national groups should guarantee women's participation and gender equality from the outset.
statements.agree: Women's equal part must be written into self-rule from the start.
statements.disagree: Self-government arrangements for Indigenous or national groups should not guarantee women's participation and gender equality from the outset.
statements.note: About women's place in group self-government.

statements.text: A state with nationalised property and a planned economy should be defended against capitalist restoration or foreign attack even when a bureaucracy rules it.
statements.agree: Such a state is worth defending even under bad rulers.
statements.disagree: A state with nationalised property and a planned economy should not be defended against capitalist restoration or foreign attack when a bureaucracy rules it.
statements.note: About defending a state-owned planned economy.

statements.text: Higher offices should be filled by delegates chosen by lower-level councils rather than by direct popular vote.
statements.agree: Local councils send delegates upward to choose the higher offices.
statements.disagree: Election by delegates chosen by lower-level councils should not replace direct popular vote for higher offices.
statements.note: About indirect, council-based selection of leaders.

statements.text: A country's traditional national church should have a special legal status above other religious bodies.
statements.agree: The national church is recognised in law above other religions.
statements.disagree: A country's traditional national church should not have a special legal status above other religious bodies.
statements.note: About a privileged legal status for a national church.

statements.text: Regions where an ethnic minority forms the majority should have territorial autonomy within the state.
statements.agree: Such regions should run many of their own affairs.
statements.disagree: Regions where an ethnic minority forms the majority should not have territorial autonomy within the state.
statements.note: About autonomy for regions of ethnic minorities.

statements.text: The inhabitants of a disputed territory should decide by vote which country it belongs to.
statements.agree: The people who live there should choose.
statements.disagree: The inhabitants of a disputed territory should not decide by vote which country it belongs to.
statements.note: About who decides the status of a disputed territory.

statements.text: A newly independent state should keep the borders drawn by its colonial rulers rather than redraw them.
statements.agree: Inherited borders should stand to avoid endless conflict.
statements.disagree: Keeping the borders drawn by colonial rulers should not take priority over redrawing them in a newly independent state.
statements.note: About whether colonial borders should be kept after independence.

statements.text: People should live as simply and self-sufficiently as possible, keeping their needs limited.
statements.agree: A good life means few needs and providing for yourself.
statements.disagree: People should not live as simply and self-sufficiently as possible, keeping their needs limited.
statements.note: About simple, self-sufficient living as an ideal.

statements.text: The authorities should restrict outside settlement in regions where an indigenous people is the original majority.
statements.agree: Settlement by outsiders should be limited to protect the indigenous majority.
statements.disagree: The authorities should not restrict outside settlement in regions where an indigenous people is the original majority.
statements.note: About limiting settlement by outsiders in indigenous homelands.

statements.text: Military conscription or draft registration should apply equally to women and men, or to neither.
statements.agree: Any draft should treat women and men alike.
statements.disagree: Military conscription or draft registration should not apply equally to women and men.
statements.note: About whether women and men should be treated alike in any military draft.

statements.text: A nation has a spiritual bond with its homeland and a duty to protect the land of its ancestors.
statements.agree: The land is part of the nation's identity, and each generation must guard it.
statements.disagree: A nation does not have a spiritual bond with its homeland and a duty to protect the land of its ancestors.
statements.note: About whether a people's tie to its land is spiritual and carries a duty.

statements.text: Suspected drug users and dealers may be killed by the state without trial.
statements.agree: Police may kill suspected drug offenders outright when that is judged necessary.
statements.disagree: Suspected drug users and dealers may not be killed by the state without trial.
statements.note: About whether the state may kill suspects without a trial.

statements.text: A country should seek close economic and diplomatic ties with China rather than rely mainly on the United States.
statements.agree: Trade, loans and diplomacy should lean toward China.
statements.disagree: Close economic and diplomatic ties with China should not take priority over relying mainly on the United States.
statements.note: About which great power a country should lean on.

statements.text: A state should protect and support members of its nation living as minorities in neighbouring countries.
statements.agree: The state looks after its people abroad, for example with funds, schooling and special rights.
statements.disagree: A state should not protect and support members of its nation living as minorities in neighbouring countries.
statements.note: About a state's duty to its nation's minorities across the border.

statements.text: Natural resources belong to everyone equally, so those who appropriate them owe compensation to all others.
statements.agree: Whoever uses land or resources owes the rest of society a share of their value.
statements.disagree: Natural resources do not belong to everyone equally, and those who appropriate them do not owe compensation to all others.
statements.note: About who owns natural resources and what users owe others.

statements.text: Self-ownership gives each person full rights over their own body and labour.
statements.agree: Each person owns themselves and may not be forced to serve others' ends.
statements.disagree: Self-ownership does not give each person full rights over their own body and labour.
statements.note: About whether people own themselves outright.

statements.text: Consumption or sales taxes on everyday goods should be cut or abolished.
statements.agree: Sales and consumption taxes on daily necessities are lowered or removed.
statements.disagree: Consumption or sales taxes on everyday goods should not be cut or abolished.
statements.note: About taxing everyday purchases.

statements.text: Social spending should be targeted at the poorest rather than provided universally.
statements.agree: Help goes mainly to those in greatest need, tested by income.
statements.disagree: Targeting social spending at the poorest should not replace providing it universally.
statements.note: About targeted versus universal social programmes.

statements.text: Political parties and interest groups stand between the people and their leader and should be bypassed.
statements.agree: The leader should deal directly with the people, not through parties, unions or other groups.
statements.disagree: It is not true that political parties and interest groups stand between the people and their leader and should be bypassed.
statements.note: About direct versus organised political representation.

statements.text: Governments should not give special legal privileges to well-connected businesses.
statements.agree: No subsidies, licences or protections that favour firms close to government.
statements.disagree: Governments may give special legal privileges to well-connected businesses.
statements.note: About whether the state may favour particular businesses.

statements.text: Politics should not be organised along religious denominations.
statements.agree: Parties and offices should cut across religious lines.
statements.disagree: Politics may be organised along religious denominations.
statements.note: About whether religion should be a basis for political organisation.

statements.text: Modern technological civilization should be combined with a return to ancestral values rather than choosing one over the other.
statements.agree: Use advanced technology while reviving the archaic values of one's people.
statements.disagree: Modern technological civilization should not be combined with a return to ancestral values.
statements.note: About combining new technology with old values.

statements.text: Women should be able to initiate divorce without their husband's consent.
statements.agree: A wife can end the marriage even when her husband refuses.
statements.disagree: Women should not be able to initiate divorce without their husband's consent.
statements.note: About whether a wife can divorce against her husband's will.

statements.text: A country's natural resources should be under national rather than foreign control.
statements.agree: Oil, minerals and similar wealth stay under national control.
statements.disagree: National control of a country's natural resources should not take priority over foreign control.
statements.note: About national control of natural resources.

statements.text: Whether a distribution of wealth is just depends on how it came about, not on how equal it is.
statements.agree: A fortune is fair if it was gained through voluntary exchange and rightful acquisition, however unequal the result.
statements.disagree: Whether a distribution of wealth is just does not depend only on how it came about.
statements.note: About judging fairness by process or by outcome.

statements.text: A small tax should be charged on international financial transactions such as currency trades.
statements.agree: A small tax should be charged on international financial transactions such as currency trades.
statements.disagree: A small tax should not be charged on international financial transactions such as currency trades.
statements.note: About taxing speculative finance.

statements.text: Racism is no longer the main obstacle to the advancement of disadvantaged racial groups.
statements.agree: Other factors such as policy, family and culture now hold people back more than racism does.
statements.disagree: Racism is still the main obstacle to the advancement of disadvantaged racial groups.
statements.note: About how much racism still limits people today.

statements.text: An unjust law is not truly law and does not bind in conscience.
statements.agree: A rule that violates basic justice lacks real authority and need not be obeyed in good conscience.
statements.disagree: An unjust law is truly law and does bind in conscience.
statements.note: About whether law gets its authority from justice or from procedure.

statements.text: Society should automate as much paid work as possible so that people can work far less.
statements.agree: Machines should take over jobs, with the gains shared so people work shorter hours.
statements.disagree: Society should not automate as much paid work as possible so that people can work far less.
statements.note: About automation and the future of work.

statements.text: The world should be organised around several independent centres of power rather than under one dominant power.
statements.agree: A balance among several large powers or civilizations protects each one's way of life.
statements.disagree: The world should not be organised around several independent centres of power.
statements.note: About one dominant power versus many.

statements.text: The value of goods is created by the labour that produces them.
statements.agree: What things are worth comes from the work put into them.
statements.disagree: The value of goods is not created by the labour that produces them.
statements.note: About where economic value comes from.

statements.text: Love of one's own country and a politics that serves ordinary working people belong together.
statements.agree: Love of one's own country and a politics that serves ordinary working people support one another.
statements.disagree: Love of one's own country and a politics that serves ordinary working people do not belong together.
statements.note: About whether patriotism fits with left-wing or worker-focused politics.

statements.text: The political left should concentrate on workers' material interests rather than cultural identity issues.
statements.agree: Wages, jobs and living standards should come first, ahead of identity and lifestyle campaigns.
statements.disagree: The political left should not put workers' material interests ahead of cultural identity issues.
statements.note: About what the left should prioritise.

statements.text: A market economy can be built within a socialist system under the leadership of a communist party.
statements.agree: A communist party can direct a market economy toward socialist goals.
statements.disagree: A market economy cannot be built within a socialist system under a communist party's leadership.
statements.note: About combining markets with party-led socialism.
